name: Steak & Rice Noodle Stir-Fry with Zucchini, Bell Pepper & Green Onion
ingredients: 1 ½ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Drain in a colander and rinse.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into thin strips. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and stir-fry until cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer steak to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a clean cutting board, trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; stir-fry until veggies are fork-tender, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the veggies are cooking, place soy sauce, water, fish sauce, and cornstarch in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine.
When the veggies are done, add sauce to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into thin pieces.
Once the sauce has thickened, add noodles, steak, and green onions to the skillet. Toss to coat and continue to cook until warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
